_doc: inocode/messages/resolve. Name the item by `id` ('#<turn>.<item>', both 1-based and file-wide; or a server item id) OR by `turnId` + `itemIndex` (a Turn.id and the 0-based position in that Turn.items of thread/read; the answer carries the file-wide numbers the GUI shows). maxChars cuts `text`. Limit (first version): for a fork that references its parent's history (history_base) only the lines of its own file are numbered; replying to a message of the parent is not supported yet.
